categories.main_business_segments: Wasion Holdings operates through three primary business segments: Power Advanced Metering Infrastructure (Power AMI), Communication and Fluid Advanced Metering Infrastructure (Communication and Fluid AMI), and Advanced Distribution Operations (ADO). Power AMI focuses on smart power meters and related system solutions; Communication and Fluid AMI specializes in communication terminals and water, gas, and heat metering products with IoT integration; ADO covers smart power distribution devices, energy storage, new energy, and energy efficiency solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group leverages advanced technologies including IoT, AI, chip design, and communication modules such as Wi-SUN and G3-PLC/BPLC for smart metering and energy management. It employs automated and intelligent manufacturing processes, including fully automatic production lines and digital factory construction. The company also develops proprietary operating systems like Power Harmony IoT and integrates AI edge computing and digital twin technologies for smart city and energy IoT applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Wasion serves a diverse customer base including major power grid companies such as State Grid and Southern Grid, local power companies, telecommunications operators, petrochemical industries, data centers, rail transport, and residential users. Its markets span domestic China and international regions including Latin America, Africa, Southeast Asia, North America, Europe, and the Middle East, targeting both power grid and non-power grid sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates extensively in China and has established production bases and subsidiaries in Tanzania, Brazil, Mexico, Hungary, Australia, Indonesia, Malaysia, and other countries. It covers markets across Asia, Africa, the Americas, and Europe, with localized manufacturing and sales operations to support its internationalization strategy.
categories.supply_chain_position: Wasion operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain, focusing on the development, manufacturing, and sales of advanced metering devices, smart distribution equipment, and integrated energy management solutions. It provides end-to-end solutions from energy production measurement to consumption management and energy efficiency services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group prioritizes R&D in smart metering, IoT, AI, chip technology, and energy storage systems aligned with national dual-carbon goals. It emphasizes innovation in power digitalization, smart grids, new energy integration, and smart city infrastructure. The company also focuses on international expansion, localization of production, and development of green, low-carbon technologies and products.
categories.revenue_model: Wasion generates revenue primarily through the sale of smart meters, communication terminals, power distribution devices, and related system solutions. It also earns income from system solution services, government grants, interest income, and rental income from investment properties. The company benefits from both domestic and international sales, with a significant portion derived from contracts with power grid companies and industrial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Wasion is a leading total solution provider in China’s advanced metering and energy efficiency management industry, holding over 20% domestic market share in high-end metering products. It is recognized as a pioneer and major international smart power grid and metering provider. The company competes with other global and domestic manufacturers in smart metering, energy storage, and smart grid solutions, leveraging its technological innovation and international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, Wasion reported revenue of approximately RMB8.72 billion, a 20% increase year-on-year, and a net profit attributable to owners of RMB706 million, up 35%. Total assets reached RMB15.7 billion with equity attributable to owners at RMB5.43 billion. The Group has demonstrated consistent growth over the past five years, expanding its international business which grew 50% in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Wasion emphasizes its position as an 'Energy Metering and Energy Saving Expert' offering comprehensive, integrated solutions covering electricity, water, gas, and heat metering. Its unique value lies in advanced technology integration (IoT, AI, chip design), full lifecycle product offerings, localization of international operations, and commitment to green, low-carbon innovation. The Group differentiates itself through high-quality products, extensive R&D, and tailored solutions for smart grids, new energy, and smart cities.
